technical_overview: Offered at $18.0 for 1.5g, this KoColor EYESHADOW is expertly formulated with Mica, Talc, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Iron Oxides, Red 40 Lake. Delivering a high-fidelity Terracotta Sunset color profile (`#E2725B`), it leverages advanced engineering via high-purity pigments and volatile carriers. For optimal chromatic impact, apply directly to a clean, prepped surface.
